l.x: Ride south-west to Fire Plume Ridge, the volcano in the middle of the crater. Bloodpetal Flayers grow around its foot. South of the hot springs, Stegodons graze and Dinosaur Bones drop from them or lie on the ground; Diemetradons nearby carry the scales Shizzle wants. Ravasaurs hunt in packs in the south-west: their claws are for Jes'rimon, and now and then one carries a Mangled Journal (a rare drop: take its quest only if you get one). Avoid Gruff, a level 57 Stegodon. Ride south-west along the western cliffs. Pterreurdactyle frénétique fly over the west side, and Bloodpetal Trappers grow in the same jungle.

La montagne débouche près du Blackrock Stronghold, plein d'orcs de niveau 55-57. Suivez la route vers l'est le long des falaises du nord jusqu'au camp de la Horde à la Flame Crest.
